item.title: n8n 3.0 Upgrade Guide: The Breaking Changes Checklist Before You Update
item.description:
Introduction

n8n 3.0, scheduled for October 2026, is the most disruptive release in the project’s recent history. It ends npm and npx installs for self-hosters, removes more than 35 legacy nodes and helpers, retires Chat Hub, and tightens security defaults that change how Code nodes, community packages, and webhooks behave. This guide is the pre-upgrade checklist for anyone running a production 2.x instance, on Docker or npm, who owns workflows that must keep working the morning after the upgrade. If you have not yet moved off npm, read our npm to Docker migration guide alongside this one, because that move is now mandatory.
